name: Arrow Home Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Arrow Home Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in design, research and development, production, sales, and service of home furnishing products in China and internationally. The company offers smart toilets, sanitary ceramics, faucets and hardware, bathroom furniture, bathtubs and shower enclosures, and tiles under the ARROW, FAENZA, and ANNWA brands. It is also involved in the information system development; e-commerce; production and sales of packaging materials; and hotel management activities. The company was formerly known as Lehua Household Co., Ltd. Arrow Home Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Foshan, China.
